_comment: Run: npx expo install <package> for each entry below.
_comment2: expo install picks the SDK-compatible version automatically.

notes.react-native-paper: Upgrade to v5 for React Native 0.74+ compatibility. v4 API is largely the same.
notes.react-native-vector-icons: Replace with @expo/vector-icons (pre-bundled in Expo SDK). Same API: import { MaterialIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
notes.react-native-map-clustering: Deprecated. Consider switching to react-native-maps built-in clustering or @gorhom/bottom-sheet.
notes.figlet: Works fine but adds bundle size. Remove if only used for the console splash.
notes.@react-navigation/drawer: Required by expo-router/drawer even though you don't import it directly.
